review_notes.evidence: Native TIFF and full-resolution bank strips; calibrated raster guide used only for coordinate alignment. Crossing and junction ownership followed from native diamonds, turns, and visible gaps.

5J B09 at row 60 and D09 at row 62 end as distinct leftward hook stubs with white separation from one another and adjacent vertical rails. RX002 5J plain native.png, independently confirmed by root. Synthetic source_open owners preserve both terminals without inventing a source.
6D.D02 at c176 and 7D.D09 at c199 both fold down into the same row-30 conductor. RX002 native c169-186 r17-32.png and RX002 native c194-203 r24-42.png; independently confirmed by root.

Native strokes also physically link 1A.main/1B.K, 1C.B05✲/1D.KB13, 1J.D09✲/1K.KB12, 3D.D06/3L.D13✲, 3F.D05✲/3M.KD12, and the 2M.B12, 5M.D19, 7L.D10✲, 7M.B13 wait-loop output conductor. Secondary output ports are recorded as additional_drivers, preserving the physical line without claiming a unique logical driver.
